description: Model-provider endpoints no Go workload may reach (ADR-0006 §2.1; AIGOV-001 no-direct-provider-call). The single source for this list. It is not an allow-list for anything: Go workloads are default-deny on egress and this list is what infra/tools/check_manifests.py proves none of their allowances can reach. Only the Model Gateway (intelligence/) has provider egress, scoped by its ProviderProfile api_hosts (contracts/schemas/ai/provider-profile.schema.json). Patterns use '*' for any run of DNS characters, dots included.
